encoding: Flat Markdown front matter; scalar strings or simple lists of strings. No nested YAML is required by the parser.
missing_values: Unknown values are omitted, never encoded as unknown/null/empty strings or guessed from filenames. student_category_status explains unassigned student categories.
identifier_format: Lowercase ASCII hyphenated lexical keys, or an explicit ALL wildcard where documented. Display labels use separate *_name fields. Keys are not verified organization IDs and do not establish equivalence between different graduate/undergraduate units.
audience: Compatibility alias of academic_level only. student_category is a separate dimension.
student_category: Assigned only when the source explicitly identifies a student group. English language, nationality, or an international admission route alone is not used to infer exclusive domestic/international eligibility.
admission_route: Admission records preserve international_admissions as source route context; this is distinct from student category. Type B explicitly permits Korean or foreign nationality.
year_semantics: Admission academic_year=2027 and term=spring describe the admission cycle. Tuition basis=fall 2026 is stored separately. No guidebook academic_year or effective_date is inferred from conflicting cover/filename years.
wildcards: campus=ALL is campus-wide. department=ALL and college=ALL are used only for genuinely unqualified all-department/all-college scope. They are not missing values. Future department/college filters must explicitly include applicable shared scope.
qualified_scope: all_in_college/all_in_listed_colleges records apply only within their named college(s); tuition_category and specified_disciplines records are qualified by those fields. Do not treat every missing department as a university-wide rule.
topic_semantics: One primary topic per unit. Topic is often better used as a ranking hint; for example GPA-certificate guidance can support a scholarship question even though its primary topic is gpa_certification.
availability_semantics: degree_level on availability records denotes the degree columns discussed, including unavailable programs. available_degree_levels and availability store the explicit outcome. Do not discard unavailable rows when answering whether a degree is offered.
source_pages: PDF page references are explicit metadata and remain in headings; the existing Markdown parser does not populate numeric chunk page_number from a heading.
parent_source_uri_semantics: Historical logical source ID, not a live file path. parent_markdown_sha256 records the removed intermediate snapshot; raw PDFs and prepared units remain hash-verifiable.
